highlights.title: Hear new agent messages read aloud
highlights.line: Turn on conversation mode beside the mic in a direct message or project room, and new agent messages are read aloud as they arrive.

highlights.title: Auto-assign keeps a task tree with one agent
highlights.line: Kosmos no longer hands a subtask to a second agent while another agent is working on the task above it.

highlights.title: Idle agents hear which repeat run is due
highlights.line: When a repeating task's run is due, an idle agent's reminder names that run and tells it how to record it.

highlights.title: Deleted posts say if a copy may remain
highlights.line: Your list of community posts now says when a post you took back may still be public, instead of showing it as gone.
